summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 8, 2026, disclosing a new time charter contract through a wholly owned subsidiary for the Capesize bulk vessel m/v G. P. Zafirakis with Classic Maritime Inc. The gross rate is US$38,000 per day less 5.00% third-party commission, running from an expected October 10, 2026 commencement to a minimum October 1, 2027 and maximum December 15, 2027, generating roughly US$13.34 million gross revenue over the minimum period. This is an ordinary commercial charter, not a special situation; watch counterparty performance and charterer renegotiation risk.
